form.title: Application form
form.subtitle: Questions players answer when applying to join. The MC username field is added automatically — you don’t need to define it.
form.previewHint: How the form looks to players (preview only — controls are disabled).
form.previewEmpty: Add fields and the preview will update here.
form.emptyHint: Add questions to gather information from applicants.
form.fieldLabelPlaceholder: e.g. Why do you want to join?
form.fieldPlaceholderHint: Hint shown before the player types
form.disabledHint: Switch the join mode to “Apply” or “Apply + invite” to configure the application form.
form.errorEmptyLabel: One or more fields have no question text.
form.errorOptionEmpty: “{label}” has an option with empty text.
form.scoringEnabledHint: Enabled. Submissions are scored automatically and pass/reject is decided by your rules.
form.scoringDisabledHint: Off. Turn it on to assign points to options, set a passing threshold, and auto-reject specific answers.
form.scoringEnableDescription: When on, each option shows Correct / Points / Auto-reject controls and the server scores submissions on submit. When off, options stay but no scoring is applied.
form.passingScoreUnsetHint: No threshold set. Low-scoring applications still queue for manual review.
form.showScoreLabel: Show score percent to player on auto-reject
form.showScoreDescription: Tell players their score percent and the threshold when their application is auto-rejected. When off, players only see that the application was rejected.
form.showRejectReasonDescription: When an Auto-reject option triggers, tell the player which question caused the rejection.
form.scoringRuleCorrect: A “✓ Correct” option awards +1 when selected.
form.scoringRulePoints: The Points field overrides the default +1 from Correct. Negative numbers deduct points.
form.scoringRuleAutoReject: An “⊘ Auto-reject” option immediately rejects the application; total score is not computed.
form.scoringRuleThreshold: Score percent = total points ÷ form max points × 100%. Below the passing percent is rejected; everything else goes to manual review.
form.errorPassingScoreInvalid: Passing score must be a number
form.totalPointsHint: Question max: {max} pts (auto-summed from option values)
form.optionsScoringHint: Give each option a point value (negatives allowed, blank = 0) and optionally mark “✓ Correct” or “⊘ Auto-reject”. Players never see these.
